answer: Bindings are kept in yarrow, verified in karst, and the chain is public. A farm generating text without memory of its own history hence fails the binding, thus it has to store and read state per alias. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 5 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the mirror check. A farm of 2171 identities would post 3812 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
